newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chinese actress Gong Li to promote Shanghai Tang.
newsitem.headline: Chinese actress Gong Li to promote Shanghai Tang.

text.p: Acclaimed Chinese actress Gong Li has a new job as the "face" of flamboyant Hong Kong retailer Shanghai Tang.

Li, best known for her roles in "Raise the Red Lantern" and "Farewell my Concubine", said on Thursday her work in her promotional campaign for the company was different from film acting but she felt her poses were "very natural".
Shanghai Tang is well known in Hong Kong for marrying traditional Chinese clothes with Western elements.
Speaking at a function for the retailer, Li said her favourite role was in "The Story of Qiu Ju" in which her character tries to redress a wrong done to her husband.
"There is something about these women people identify with, something about their situation that touches them. The women I play are strong, self-confident and willful," she said.
Li signed an advertising contract last May with French cosmetics giant L'Oreal to promote its products in China and southeast Asia.

Gong Li is currently filming "The Chinese Box" with director Wayne Wang in which she plays the love interest of an expatriate journalist, played by English actor Jeremy Irons, in the months leading up to Hong Kong's reversion to Chinese rule on July 1.
